In Islamic tradition, Dema is considered a blessed name, as it is associated with the concept of abundance and prosperity. The name Dema is also mentioned in the Quran, where it refers to a place of abundance and fertility. In modern times, the name Dema has been adopted by many Muslim cultures around the world, and is often given to girls born into families of Arab or Middle Eastern descent. Dema is a popular name in many Muslim-majority countries, including Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates. It is also a common name in many non-Muslim countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia.
